steps.interpretation: yarn classic consumes --ignore-engines only when it appears before the script name. Placed after it, the flag was forwarded to the script and yarn applied its engine check to the run command, refusing it for the same reason as the declared baseline. The step is recorded as it ran; it was not re-issued with the flag moved.

nonclaims: Overriding the engine gate does not make Node 16.20.2 the declared cell, and nothing here is evidence about behavior in the declared Node 12.14.1 cell.
A recorded install or build outcome establishes no browser behavior, journey coverage, migration feasibility, pilot status, or production readiness.
With lifecycle scripts disabled, native postinstall steps did not run; an install recorded here is not a working development environment.
